title: AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.33644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research ideas are always proposed under resource constraints: a plan must fit the available compute, API credit, and time. Yet evaluations of research-ideation agents mostly score unconstrained novelty or overlap with a published paper, and their LLM judges are rarely checked against peer review. We introduce AlphaIdeaBench, a benchmark of 100 ideation tasks (50 workshop calls for papers and 50 open problems stated in surveys), each paired with an explicit resource budget and a shared proposal schema. An LLM judge scores each proposal on 12 dimensions covering validity, novelty, and feasibility. To validate the judge, we compare its scores on four novelty axes (problem, method, scenario, and insight) with scores derived from reviewer comments on 600 papers from ICLR 2026, NeurIPS 2025, and ICML 2025. translated_title: AlphaIdeaBench：在可行性约束下评估自动化研究想法生成并与同行评审对齐的基准
translated_abstract: 研究想法总是在资源约束下被提出的：一个研究计划必须符合可用的计算资源、API额度和时间。然而，现有对研究构思智能体的评估大多只衡量无约束的新颖性或与已发表论文的重叠度，而且其大模型评审员很少经过与同行评审结果的对照检验。我们提出了AlphaIdeaBench，一个包含100个构思任务的基准（50个来自研讨会征稿启事，50个来自综述中陈述的开放问题），每个任务都配有明确的资源预算和统一的提案格式。一个大模型评审员从12个维度对每个提案进行评分，涵盖有效性、新颖性和可行性。为验证该评审员的可靠性，我们将其在四个新颖性维度（问题、方法、场景和洞见）上的评分与基于ICLR 2026、NeurIPS 2025和ICML 2025共600篇论文的审稿意见推导出的分数进行比较。在问题和方法新颖性上，Gemini 3.7 Flash在94%–97%的论文上与审稿推导分数相差不超过一分；在场景（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出了AlphaIdeaBench，首个在真实资源可行性约束下评估自动化研究想法生成的基准，并利用600篇顶会论文的同行评审意见验证了大模型评审员评分的可靠性。
en_tdlr: AlphaIdeaBench is a benchmark of 100 resource-constrained research ideation tasks whose LLM judge is validated against peer-review-derived scores from 600 top-conference papers.
